name: task IDs, updates, and compact task JSON
test:
m=SimpleTaskManager()
a=m.add_task(1,'same',1); b=m.add_task(2,'same',2)
assert (a,b)==('task_id_1','task_id_2')
assert m.get_task(3,a)=='{"name":"same","priority":1}'
assert m.update_task(4,a,'changed',3) is True
assert m.get_task(5,a)=='{"name":"changed","priority":3}'
assert m.update_task(6,'task_id_9','x',0) is False
assert m.get_task(7,'task_id_9') is None

name: search uses current names and numeric priority ties
input: 12 tasks with tied priority and one updated name
test:
m=SimpleTaskManager()
for i in range(1,13): m.add_task(i,'Item' if i<12 else 'other',2)
assert m.search_tasks(13,'Item',15)==[f'task_id_{i}' for i in range(1,12)]
assert m.update_task(14,'task_id_12','Item',3)
assert m.search_tasks(15,'Item',3)==['task_id_12','task_id_1','task_id_2']
assert m.search_tasks(16,'item',4)==[]
assert m.list_tasks_sorted(17,2)==['task_id_12','task_id_1']
assert m.list_tasks_sorted(18,0)==[]

name: quota releases at expiry boundary
test:
m=SimpleTaskManager(); a=m.add_task(1,'A',1); b=m.add_task(2,'B',1)
assert m.add_user(3,'u',1) and not m.add_user(4,'u',2)
assert m.assign_task(5,a,'u',8)
assert not m.assign_task(6,b,'u',9)
assert m.get_user_tasks(7,'u')==[a]
assert m.get_user_tasks(8,'u')==[]
assert m.get_overdue_assignments(9,'u')==[a]
assert m.assign_task(10,b,'u',12)
assert m.get_user_tasks(11,'u')==[b]

name: duplicate assignments and earliest completion
input: same task assigned twice, complete first only
test:
m=SimpleTaskManager(); a=m.add_task(1,'A',1); m.add_user(2,'u',2)
assert m.assign_task(3,a,'u',9)
assert m.assign_task(4,a,'u',8)
assert m.get_user_tasks(5,'u')==[a,a]
assert m.complete_task(6,a,'u')
assert m.get_user_tasks(7,'u')==[a]
assert m.get_overdue_assignments(8,'u')==[a]
assert not m.complete_task(9,a,'u')
assert m.get_overdue_assignments(10,'u')==[a]

name: overdue order and missing entities
input: two overdue assignments ordered by finish time
test:
m=SimpleTaskManager(); a=m.add_task(1,'A',0); b=m.add_task(2,'B',0)
assert m.get_user_tasks(3,'ghost')==[]
assert m.get_overdue_assignments(4,'ghost')==[]
assert not m.assign_task(5,a,'ghost',8)
m.add_user(6,'u',2)
assert not m.assign_task(7,'task_id_8','u',11)
assert m.assign_task(8,a,'u',14)
assert m.assign_task(9,b,'u',12)
assert m.get_overdue_assignments(13,'u')==[b]
assert m.get_overdue_assignments(15,'u')==[b,a]

name: overdue history retains repeated task assignments
input: same task assigned twice with different finish times
test:
m=SimpleTaskManager(); a=m.add_task(1,'A',0); m.add_user(2,'u',2)
assert m.assign_task(3,a,'u',7)
assert m.assign_task(4,a,'u',8)
assert m.get_overdue_assignments(7,'u')==[a]
assert m.get_overdue_assignments(8,'u')==[a,a]
assert m.get_user_tasks(9,'u')==[]
